interpretation: Median ~33-40 ms per frame (25-30 fps) at full detail on this integrated GPU. First-pass spikes (render max 295 ms) did not recur on repeat with no new shader programs, so they look like one-off first-draw uploads or GPU contention (cause UNVERIFIED). These figures cannot be used as a frame-rate claim for players.
